  name: postgres-0

    app: postgres

  nodeName: node-a
  containers:

      image: postgres:16.4
status:
  phase: Running
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web-1
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  containers:
    - name: web
      image: nginx:1.27
    - name: proxy
      image: envoyproxy/envoy:v1.31
---
apiVersion: apps/v1

  name: web

apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2

      version: 6.7.0
